Standard IS 17803:2022: Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification.
Sector: Consumer Goods & Utensils | Year: 2022 | Status: Current / Mandatory under QCO 2023 | Effective: 2023-06-01.
Applicable Products: stainless steel water bottle, stainless steel flask, vacuum insulated water bottle, insulated metal flask, double walled steel bottle, thermo steel bottle.
Product Characteristics: Food contact austenitic stainless steel material (Grade SS 304 / SS 316 / IS 6911); Double-walled vacuum thermal insulation; Nominal liquid holding capacity from 250 ml to 2000 ml; Leak-proof cap with food-grade silicone gasket.
Intended Use: Safe storage and thermal temperature retention of drinking water and potable beverages; Domestic and outdoor hydration.

text:
Standard IS 17803:2022 (Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification) - Clause 4.1: Material of Construction & Food Grade Steel.
Category: Material specification | Page: 3 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Inner body and outer casing in contact with beverage shall be manufactured from austenitic stainless steel Grade X04Cr19Ni9 (SS 304) or X02Cr17Ni12Mo2 (SS 316) conforming to IS 6911. Heavy metal extraction test (Lead < 0.01 mg/kg, Cadmium < 0.005 mg/kg) must comply with IS 9845.
Test Method: Spectrometric chemical analysis conforming to IS 228 and Overall Migration Test under IS 9845
Required Compliance Evidence: Raw material Mill Test Certificate (MTC) + NABL Spectrometry Chemical Composition Report

text:
Standard IS 17803:2022 (Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification) - Clause 5.2: Thermal Insulation Retention Test.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 5 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: The vacuum flask filled with boiling water (min 95°C) and sealed at ambient temperature (27±2°C) shall retain minimum temperature of 60°C after 6 hours for small flasks (<500ml) and minimum 65°C after 6 hours for flasks >750ml.
Test Method: Calibrated thermal sensor immersion test in controlled climatic chamber over 6-hour interval
Required Compliance Evidence: In-house / NABL Calibrated Thermal Insulation Retention Test Report

text:
Standard IS 17803:2022 (Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification) - Clause 6.1: Leakage & Inversion Pressure Resistance.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 7 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Flask filled to rated capacity with liquid, capped tightly, and inverted for 30 minutes at room temperature and subjected to 20 kPa internal pressure must show zero liquid seepage or gasket deformation.
Test Method: Inversion leak test bench with hydrostatic air pressure gauge
Required Compliance Evidence: Leakage and pressure tightness test log sheet

Standard IS 17803:2022 (Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification) - Clause 7.3: Drop Impact and Handle Dynamic Strength.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 8 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Filled bottle dropped from a height of 1.0 meter onto hardwood floor in 3 orientations (base, cap, side) shall show no rupture, vacuum loss, or leakage.
Test Method: Standard drop tester apparatus (1.0m height)
Required Compliance Evidence: Drop test observation report and vacuum post-drop verification

Standard IS 17803:2022 (Stainless Steel Vacuum Flasks / Insulated Water Bottles - Specification) - Clause 8.1: Marking, Capacity Stamping & ISI License Layout.
Category: Product marking | Page: 10 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Every bottle must be permanently laser-etched on base with: 1. Manufacturer Name / Trademark, 2. Nominal Capacity in ml, 3. Steel Grade (e.g., SUS 304), 4. Standard Mark (ISI Logo) with CM/L License Number.
Test Method: Visual and abrasion resistance inspection of laser etching
Required Compliance Evidence: Artwork approval sheet & sample laser etching photo with CM/L number

Requirement Details: Kettles shall be permanently marked with rated voltage (230V AC), rated power (W), model identifier, water level MAX indicator, and ISI mark with CML license number.

Standard IS 302-2-15:2009 (Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids (Electric Kettles)) - Clause 13.2: Leakage Current & Dielectric Strength at Operating Temperature.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 7 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Leakage current under operating temperature shall not exceed 0.75 mA for Class I portable appliances. High voltage insulation must withstand 1000V AC for 1 minute without breakdown.
Test Method: Calibrated leakage current meter and High Voltage Dielectric breakdown tester
Required Compliance Evidence: NABL Electrical Type Test Report covering Clause 13 & 16

Standard IS 302-2-15:2009 (Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Particular Requirements for Appliances for Heating Liquids (Electric Kettles)) - Clause 19.101: Abnormal Operation and Boil-Dry Protection.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 9 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Kettles energized without water at 1.15 times rated power input must trigger automatic thermal cut-out before vessel temperature exceeds 200°C, with zero flame or molten material risk.
Test Method: Dry boil abnormal operation test chamber with thermocouple logging
Required Compliance Evidence: Thermal cut-out response log & boil-dry safety test certificate

Standard IS 3196 (Part 1):2013 (Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases (LPG Cylinders)) - Clause 4.1: Steel Chemistry & Mechanical Properties.
Category: Material specification | Page: 3 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Steel sheets must comply with IS 6240 Grade 1. Carbon max 0.16%, Manganese 0.30-0.80%, Sulphur & Phosphorus max 0.035% each. Tensile strength min 350-450 MPa with min 25% elongation.

Standard IS 3196 (Part 1):2013 (Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases (LPG Cylinders)) - Clause 8.2: Hydrostatic Proof Pressure & Volumetric Expansion Test.
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 8 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Every cylinder manufactured shall undergo 100% hydrostatic proof pressure testing at 2.45 MPa (25 kgf/cm2) with zero leakage. Permanent volumetric expansion must not exceed 10% of total expansion.
Test Method: Water jacket hydrostatic test installation with digital manometer
Required Compliance Evidence: Batch Hydrostatic Test Record Log signed by Quality Inspector

Requirement Details: TDS max 500 mg/L, pH 6.5 to 8.5, Turbidity max 2 NTU, Total Hardness max 200 mg/L, Chlorides max 200 mg/L, Heavy metals: Lead max 0.01 mg/L, Arsenic max 0.01 mg/L.

Standard IS 15410:2003 (Containers for Packaging of Natural Mineral Water and Packaged Drinking Water - Specification) - Clause 4.1: Raw Material Grade & Overall Migration Limit.

Required Compliance Evidence: NABL Flash Tester Calibration Curve & Power Output Matrix

Standard IS 14286:1995 (Crystalline Silicon Terrestrial Photovoltaic (PV) Modules - Design Qualification and Type Approval) - Clause 10.11: Thermal Cycling (200 Cycles -40°C to +85°C) & Damp Heat (1000 Hours).
Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 14 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Module subjected to 200 thermal cycles between -40°C and +85°C with current injection, followed by 1000 hours at 85°C / 85% RH. Power degradation must not exceed 5%.
Test Method: Walk-in environmental climatic simulation chamber with continuous IV curve monitoring
Required Compliance Evidence: 200-cycle Thermal & Damp Heat Environmental Aging Report

Category: Safety & Performance test | Page: 19 | Status: Yes (Mandatory QCO).
Requirement Details: Module mounted on frame subjected to dynamic pneumatic pressure load of 5400 Pa (front face snow load) and 2400 Pa (rear face wind suction) with zero cell micro-cracking.
